Prepare the input directory of a simulation

Source: R/setup_inputs.R
setup_inputs.Rd

setup_inputs creates in one call all the input files needed by run_3DCMCCFEM for a site, named as required by the model, and copies the species parameterizations of the version 5.7 shipped with the package (see list_species).

Usage

setup_inputs(
  site,
  inputdir,
  stand,
  soil,
  topo,
  meteo,
  co2,
  management = NULL,
  species = NULL
)

Arguments

site

Character: name of the site, used to name the files.

inputdir

Character: input directory (created if it does not exist).

stand, soil, topo, meteo, co2, management

Each input can be:

  • the path of an existing file, copied in inputdir with the name required by the model (e.g. site_stand.txt);

  • a list of arguments of the corresponding helper (make_stand, make_soil, make_topo, make_meteo, make_co2, make_management), without site and outdir;

  • for meteo, a data.frame of daily data passed to make_meteo; for stand and soil, a data.frame with the columns of the file; for co2, a data.frame with year and CO2_ppm; for topo, the elevation of the site (m).

management is optional (needed with man = "var").

species

Character: species parameterizations to copy from the package. Default to the species of the stand file. Files already in inputdir (e.g. site-specific parameterizations) are kept.

Value

Invisibly, the named paths of the input files.

See also

check_inputs, run_3DCMCCFEM

Examples

inp <- file.path(tempdir(), "Collelongo")
setup_inputs("Collelongo", inp,
             stand = list(year = 2000, age = 100, species = "Fagussylvatica",
                          n_trees = 800, avdbh = 30, height = 22),
             soil = list(lat = 41.85, lon = 13.59, clay = 20, silt = 40, sand = 40),
             topo = 1560,
             meteo = system.file("extdata", "soro", "Soroe_meteo.txt", package = "R3DFEM"),
             co2 = list(years = 1997:2099, co2 = 380))
#> Outdir does not exist. It will be created
#> file /tmp/RtmpFzSWWq/Collelongo/Collelongo_stand.txt saved
#> file /tmp/RtmpFzSWWq/Collelongo/Collelongo_soil.txt saved
#> file /tmp/RtmpFzSWWq/Collelongo/Collelongo_topo.txt saved
#> file /tmp/RtmpFzSWWq/Collelongo/Collelongo_co2.txt saved
list.files(inp)
#> [1] "Collelongo_co2.txt"   "Collelongo_meteo.txt" "Collelongo_soil.txt" 
#> [4] "Collelongo_stand.txt" "Collelongo_topo.txt"  "Fagussylvatica.txt"
